input: Find overnight, sleepaway and residential summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Tryon, Columbus, Saluda, Lake Lure, Chimney Rock, Rutherfordton and Forest City, NC, and Landrum, SC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
